name: Please Verify Before Existing
source:
Meet Darcy, a young adult just trying to get their gender marker changed.
Along the way, you'll deal with a warlock who's been stuck here for 200 years, a goblin clerk with no patience and an undead lich who might be the only one keeping things together behind the scenes.
